authorship: Codex-authored synthetic questions and evidence labels, fixed before first retrieval; not user-annotated or an external benchmark.
label_policy: Relevant means the chunk directly supports an explicitly requested fact. Topic overlap alone is insufficient. All necessary sections of multi-part questions are labeled. Negative cases have no answer in this corpus. Chinese cases are a separate paired language stress test, never pooled with English scores.
